messages:
InfraBot: [ALERT] reservation pool us-west2-p4d depleted 85% (waitlist 42). Alert id: resv-2039
Alex (infra): FYI — customers hitting allocation failures for reserved p4d capacity in us-west2. Observed lead time ~18d. Will cause degraded throughput for Dedicated tenants.
Priya (oncall): Oof. Which tenants? Any high-SLA ones?
Alex (infra): Two enterprise tenants on Dedicated: Acme Payments & Ledgerly. Also several internal infra tests queued. Logs:
```
resv-check --pool us-west2-p4d --status
Pool: us-west2-p4d
Allocated: 920/1100
Pending: 42
Lead_time_est: 18d
```
Maria (finance): Quick cost estimate for short-term burst if we buy 8 extra p4d-equivalent for 30 days in us-east1 (fallback region): ~$68k for 30d + egress. Cross-region sync adds ~12%.
Jonah (infra): Options to consider:
1) Cross-region fallback to us-east1 (requires weight sync + routing)
2) Emergency short-term reserved commits in us-west2 (coord w/ sales)
3) Reprioritize queue (defer low-priority internal jobs)
4) Temporary spot->reserved migration for non-critical workloads
Sam (infra): I'll spin up a canary fallback in us-east1 and test inference latency. Command I'll run:
`resv-cli reassign --from us-west2-p4d --to us-east1-p4d --count 8 --mode canary`
Priya (oncall): Check model pinning — some tenants pinned to a specific model build; cross-region fallback may require compatible variant or quantization profile.
Alex (infra): @Priya good call. @Maria please ok budget for short-term buys? If yes, we'll request finance sign-off and coordinate with sales.
Maria (finance): Can approve up to $50k without exec sign-off. Anything above needs CFO ok. The 8-unit estimate is borderline. Can you run a 15-day estimate?
Alex (infra): Will do. Sam — start canary in us-east1 and post perf numbers. Jonah — draft priority rule to defer internal infra tests and low-cost batch jobs.
Jonah (infra): Draft snippet to update queue prioritization:
```
queuectl set-priority --queue=reserved-waitlist --policy="defer:internal_tests,scale-down:batch_low"
```
InfraBot: Incident update: status=investigating, severity=high, incident_id=resv-2039
Sam (infra): Canary results after 5m: p95 latency +42ms vs us-west2, throughput steady. No auth issues. Logs: https://logs.redwood.internal/resv-2039
Priya (oncall): If latency delta acceptable for lower-tier customers we can route them. For Acme/ Ledgerly — need explicit opt-in. @Alex please coordinate.
Alex (infra): I'll contact account PMs now. Also starting a temporary waitlist TTL reduction to free slots for critical tenants.
Maria (finance): New 15-day estimate: ~$34k + ~6% egress. Approve if confirmed.
Alex (infra): Approved. Action items: Sam start /check + reassign canary (IN PROGRESS). Jonah update queue policy + add labels (IN PROGRESS). Priya coordinate with PMs + confirm model variants. Maria finalize charge and set temporary budget flag.
Priya (oncall): tagging: @acme-pm @ledgerly-pm — please confirm if you want fallback routing.
Alex (infra): Will update thread with customer responses. Keeping this open until pool < 75% allocated.
Maria (finance): Marking budget flag: TEMP_RESV_BURST_2039
InfraBot: Next automated check scheduled in 15m.
